The AI's reports, one row a report

Source: R/ai_outputs.R
tfl_ai_outputs.Rd

The list a person checks the AI's work by: every report the answers make (tfl_ai_collect_answers()'s manifest, ai/manifest.csv) and every draft report file there, with where it is from and how far it got. A screen shows it in three levels – the shell sheets, the TOC items, the reports – by its sheet and toc_id.

Usage

tfl_ai_outputs(study_dir = ".")

Arguments

study_dir

The study folder.

Value

A data frame, one row a report: sheet (its request's shell sheets, | between them), shell_code (the id written at the top of its shell, the TOC entry's), toc_id (its TOC row's number, as the answer lists it; else its TOC entry's id – a part's, its number's), output_id, title (as the answer lists it, else its report file's label), population (its analysis set), split (how its TOC row is split for it), request, status (ok, warning, error, no answer, not answered; draft for a report file no answer lists), rtf (its RTF, NA when none), problem (why it has none), questions (the open questions in ai/questions.md naming it), adopted (no; yes; yes, draft newer – the draft differs from the study's file adopted from it) and file (its draft report file).

See also

tfl_ai_expected_write() for the list the person expects.
